gloss: carving chisel; woodcarving knife; engraving tool

definitions.gloss: carving chisel; woodcarving knife; engraving tool
definitions.explanation: A hand tool with a sharp blade used for carving or engraving wood, linoleum, or other materials.

examples.english: To carve wood with a chisel.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小学校|しょうがっこう}→小学校：01055_shougakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{図工|ずこう}→図工：19698_zukou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{彫刻刀|ちょうこくとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: I used carving chisels during arts and crafts class in elementary school.

examples.japanese: {彫刻刀|ちょうこくとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{刃|は}→刃：09865_ha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欠|か}けた→欠ける：13167_kakeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧もの⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}い→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: The blade on my carving chisel chipped, so I went to buy a new one.

notes:
In Japanese schools, students typically use a set of {彫刻刀|ちょうこくとう} during art class (⟦{図工|ずこう}→図工：19698_zukou⟧) for woodblock printing (⟦{版画|はんが}→版画：10582_hanga⟧). Standard school sets include several blade types such as {丸刀|まるとう} (round gouge), {平刀|ひらとう} (flat chisel), {三角刀|さんかくとう} (V-gouge), and {切出|きりだ}し{刀|とう} (cutting knife).
